newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: Fletcher Energy changes hedge position.
newsitem.headline: Fletcher Energy changes hedge position.

text.p: Fletcher Challenge Energy Ltd said on Thursday it had changed its hedge position.

In its interim report published in February it said that on December 31 4.14 million barrels of oil had been sold forward at an average price of US$21.43 per barrel, and that these contracts matured over the period January to May.
That position has recently changed in the following respects, Fletcher said:
- 300,000 barrels of April Tapis swaps had been rolled into June; and
- a further 300,000 barrels of June Tapis swaps have been entered into.
Fletcher Energy now has 1,730,000 barrels of Tapis swaps at a weighted average price of US$22.22 per barrel.
These contracts mature over the months of April, May and June 1997.
